note: Set B captures more of the sheet's substantive millwork information correctly — QZ countertop material, the 3/4" MDF gable finish, bulkhead cladding/finish, the 1/2" MDF finish panel with P3, the 8'-4" East Island overall width, the 2'-5 1/16" laundry millwork width, and the MIN. 12" clear platform condition. Set A invents conditions ("measured from floor to top surface", "above countertop"), misbinds 6'-7 1/2" to MWK04 width and 5" to a faucet/backsplash, and repeats the CENTER MODULE scale claim under a truncated name. Both sets repeat the same dubious bindings (MWK04 width 2'-0", DINING TABLE top thickness 5"), but B's errors are fewer and its coverage of materials and clearances is stronger.
remarks: Both sets bind 2'-0" to MWK04 width although the elevation shows MWK04 at 3'-3 3/4" (2'-0" appears in the D5 section, likely a depth/other dimension), and both bind 5" to a DINING TABLE top thickness although the 5" callouts sit in the sink/section area; these shared bindings are counted as wrong in both. Neither set picks up 7'-0 1/8", 6 1/2", 4'-0", or the '1" EITHER SIDE' half of the platform clearance note. Several dimension-to-component assignments cannot be resolved from the text layer alone and required reading the drawing, so confidence is medium.
